name: Apex Analytics - Next-Gen Swarm Ops Dashboard
description: Minimalist operational analytics dashboard inspired by Tremor and shadcn/ui. Features collapsible sidebar telemetry, Tremor-style KPI metric cards with SVG sparklines, interactive multi-dataset HTML5 canvas area chart, filterable and searchable data table, and modal dialogs.
whenToUse: SaaS operational dashboards, telemetry monitors, and cloud metrics panels
Data visualization interfaces requiring clean KPI cards and interactive area charts
Admin portals with searchable, filterable, and paginated data tables

keyComponents: Tremor-style KPI Metric Cards with Trend Badges & SVG Sparklines (.kpi-card)
Interactive Smooth Bezier Area Chart with Hover Crosshairs (#analytics-chart)
Metric Switcher Tabs (Tokens, Revenue, Active Swarms)
Filterable and Searchable Simulation Data Table (.data-table)
